tests.test_docker_runtime.DockerRuntimeP.negative_case_disposition: A missing concrete interpreter still fails closed before IO; provider-neutral planning itself no longer rejects non-Docker runtime kinds.
tests.test_docker_runtime.DockerRuntimeP.obsolete_assumption_disposition: The frozen Docker aggregate owned planning and therefore rejected every other runtime. Current core planning is provider-neutral and operations selects a registered interpreter later.
tests.test_docker_runtime.DockerRuntimeP.rationale: Rejecting AWS or another runtime during pure planning would violate the extracted multi-runtime architecture. The current split preserves fail-closed execution without making Docker the planner.

tests.test_effect_dispatch.EffectDispatc.negative_case_disposition: Unknown runtime kinds and missing registered interpreters return explicit unsupported outcomes before interpreter IO.
tests.test_effect_dispatch.EffectDispatc.obsolete_assumption_disposition: Concrete interpreters no longer expose a mutable self-advertised capability frozenset; the composition root supplies a closed RuntimeKind-to-interpreter map.
tests.test_effect_dispatch.EffectDispatc.rationale: The current dispatcher makes interpreter availability explicit configuration instead of trusting mutable capability claims made by an interpreter instance.

tests.test_effect_material.EffectMateria.negative_case_disposition: Secret-shaped literals and undeclared environment material remain rejected, while secret delivery retains only references and grants.
tests.test_effect_material.EffectMateria.obsolete_assumption_disposition: The frozen effect descriptor redacted all environment values. Current product language deliberately treats admitted public and socket-derived environment values as inspectable pinned runtime material.
tests.test_effect_material.EffectMateria.rationale: Redacting declared public configuration would make accepted graph material unverifiable. Current descriptors expose bounded public values but continue to exclude plaintext and ciphertext secrets.

tests.test_effect_values.EffectValueTest.negative_case_disposition: Review work is rejected at the runtime-effect boundary, missing interpreters fail before IO, socket-only operations are recorded without runtime IO, and unsupported concrete effects remain explicit.
tests.test_effect_values.EffectValueTest.obsolete_assumption_disposition: The frozen monolith assigned one EffectCapability enum to every activity. Current ownership is expressed by closed ActivityOperation values, RuntimeKind dispatch, ingress adapters, and operations-owned non-effect handling.
tests.test_effect_values.EffectValueTest.rationale: A single capability enum conflated planning operations with concrete effect ownership. The extracted architecture uses typed operations and explicit adapter selection without restoring that parallel vocabulary.
